description: Cheminements accessibles PMR is a dataset listed in GPSO - Grand Paris Seine Ouest - OpenData open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Seine Ouest. Localisation des cheminements accessibles aux personnes à mobilité réduite (PMR) sur le Territoire de Grand Paris Seine Ouest Retrouvez la carte des aménagements en faveur des personnes à mobilité réduite sur SoCarto. Coverage: Grand Paris Seine Ouest. The portal files it under Accessibilité, Transports, Déplacements, Mobilité. Its keywords are PMR, Boulogne-Billancourt, Chaville, Issy-Les-Moulineaux, Marnes-La-Coquette, Meudon. The portal shows 2,723 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2026-09-29 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte (Etalab) (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/wp-content/uploads/2014/05/Licence_Ouverte.pdf). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support cycling and walking network and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-seineouest-fr-portal.
